name: CSG Compact Premium Natal Report (private draft)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ sectionId: $json.sectionId, repairAttempt: 1, role: $json.narrativeFactPack.role, wordLimit: $json.narrativeFactPack.wordLimit, facts: $json.narrativeFactPack.facts }) }}

parameters.jsCode: const item = $input.first().json; const original = $('Loop Over Four Compiler Slots').item.json; const response = item.body ?? item; if (!response || response.sectionId !== original.sectionId || !Array.isArray(response.blocks) || response.blocks.length < 1) throw new Error(`repair rejected for ${original.sectionId}`); const allowed = new Set((original.narrativeFactPack.facts || []).map(f => f.id)); for (const block of response.blocks) { if (!['narrative','reflection','practical'].includes(block.role) || typeof block.prose !== 'string' || !block.prose.trim() || !Array.isArray(block.factIds) || block.factIds.some(id => !allowed.has(id))) throw new Error(`repair strict validation failed for ${original.sectionId}`); } return [{ json: { ...original, narrativeBlock: { sectionId: original.sectionId, blocks: response.blocks }, _repairAttempt: 1 } }];
const items = $input.all(); if (items.length !== 1 || !items[0].json.narrativeBlock) throw new Error('accumulator received no validated slot'); return items;

const candidates = [...$('Accumulate Validated Slot').all(), ...$input.all()].map(i => i.json); const bySection = new Map(); for (const item of candidates) { const id = item.narrativeBlock?.sectionId; if (id && item.narrativeBlock) bySection.set(id, item); } const expected = ['identity','inner-world','integration','dynamics']; if (bySection.size !== 4 || expected.some(id => !bySection.has(id))) throw new Error('final quality gate rejected incomplete narrative slots'); const first = bySection.get(expected[0]); const blocks = expected.map(id => bySection.get(id).narrativeBlock); return [{ json: { schemaVersion: 'csg-compact-report-callback-v1', reportId: first.reportId, status: 'approved', reportType: 'natal', skeleton: first._deterministicSnapshot.skeleton, tables: first._deterministicSnapshot.tables, blocks } }];
